lost_glove.name: Red Glove
lost_glove.description: Hand it in at Castle Halt. A child's glove, left hand. The name tape inside says SCHOOL and nothing else.

lost_hat.name: Felt Hat
lost_hat.description: Hand it in at Castle Halt. A man's hat. He said he would only be a moment.

lost_tin.name: Dinner Tin
lost_tin.description: Hand it in at Castle Halt. A carter's dinner tin. The sandwiches inside are fresh.

key_left_luggage.name: Trunk Key
key_left_luggage.description: Opens the trunk on the platform at Castle Halt. Stamped G.M.Co. It's heavier than the lock needs.

key_nurses_case.name: Case Key
key_nurses_case.description: Opens the nurse's case. A small key on a hospital tag. The tag gives a ward number and no hospital.

nurses_parcel.name: Parcel for Mrs Allen
nurses_parcel.description: Use to read the label. Dressings, made up in a neat hand, for the door facing the fire in Castle square.

haversack.name: Walker's Haversack
haversack.description: Use to read the label: if found, return to Lost Property, Castle Halt. Canvas, dry inside.
